appended_items.title: Abstract Gap Restoration via Passage Selection and Sentence Ordering
Palm-Leaf Reading Paths
appended_items.novel_reason: ordered handwritten-line path recovery from damaged palm-leaf manuscripts is a strong document-CV output shape
appended_items.design_trick: Score reading-path geometry and order together instead of treating the manuscript as OCR or segmentation only.

appended_items.title: Legal Paragraph Ordering and Discourse State Recovery
Seismic Evidence Forensics
appended_items.novel_reason: combines waveform evidence, dispersion imagery, and validity-curve forensics in a nonstandard geophysical task
appended_items.design_trick: Fuse multiple seismic evidence views and score whether a proposed physical curve is supported.

appended_items.title: Highway Platoon Signature Reconstruction
appended_items.novel_reason: privacy-reduced vehicle signature panels require ordered sequence reconstruction rather than detection
appended_items.design_trick: Use de-identified sensor-card panels to reconstruct an ordered operational sequence.

appended_items.title: Central European Pretraining Curriculum
appended_items.novel_reason: curriculum design as a scored ordered pretraining plan is an unusual CPU language-model benchmark pattern
appended_items.design_trick: Ask solvers to choose and order training examples under curriculum constraints, not just classify text.

appended_items.title: Anonymous Visual Operator Relay
appended_items.novel_reason: few-shot visual operator inference with a decoy support pair creates a reusable in-context CV pattern
appended_items.design_trick: Provide support transformations inside each case and require identifying the shared operator before applying it.

appended_items.title: Contract Workflow Reconstruction
appended_items.novel_reason: legal workflow graph recovery from scattered contract clauses is a strong RAG structured-output pattern
appended_items.design_trick: Turn retrieval evidence into an ordered conditional workflow graph with dependencies.

appended_items.title: Cymbal Excitation-and-Damping Program Recovery
appended_items.novel_reason: real multimodal percussion recordings are decoded into an executable performance recipe
appended_items.design_trick: Recover hit and damping programs from audio/video/motion evidence instead of predicting an instrument label.
